scenes.say: In nineteen thirty-two, Australia went to war. Against birds.
scenes.cap: In 1932, Australia went to WAR. Against BIRDS.

scenes.say: About twenty thousand emus were eating farmers' wheat in Western Australia.
scenes.cap: About 20,000 EMUS were eating farmers' wheat in Western Australia.

scenes.say: So the army sent soldiers. With two machine guns.
scenes.cap: So the army sent SOLDIERS. With two MACHINE GUNS.

scenes.say: The emus split into small groups, and ran. Fast.
scenes.cap: The emus split into small groups, and RAN. FAST.

scenes.say: The commander said they could face machine guns, like tanks.
scenes.cap: The commander said they could face machine guns, like TANKS.

scenes.say: After almost ten thousand bullets, the army gave up.
scenes.cap: After almost 10,000 BULLETS, the army GAVE UP.

scenes.say: They claimed about a thousand birds. Out of twenty thousand.
scenes.cap: They claimed about 1,000 birds. Out of 20,000.

upload.title: Australia Lost a War… to Birds 🐦 #shorts
upload.description:
In late 1932, Australian soldiers with two Lewis machine guns were sent to cull emus that were destroying wheat crops in Western Australia. After about 9,860 rounds and a claimed 986 kills, the operation was called off.

Read more: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emu_War
